propositions: Recalled plan-review findings are re-surfaced with hardcoded empty evidence and impact, causing Pass-2 verification to rubber-stamp bare assertions instead of re-grounding claims against current plan text

Prior findings lose their evidence during recall injection, then after re-verification and persistence are indistinguishable from fresh findings, re-qualifying for recall on the next round and creating a permanent ratchet
Material changes between review rounds are not checked during recall eligibility, causing findings resolved by plan edits to replay verbatim across multiple rounds
Prior findings with no persisted grounding evidence should be ineligible for recall, as they represent failed previous recall attempts that became self-perpetuating
Fresh-finding verification remains unaffected by recall regrounding changes, and Pass-2 validity backstop continues to drop candidates that current plan resolves
